title: Will the DOJ’s investigation into a16z spook other VCs?
summary: On the latest episode of Equity, we wonder why the DOJ is investigating startup board seats.
llm_summary: The Department of Justice has opened a probe into Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) over how the firm secures board seats at the startups it backs, looking for possible antitrust or securities violations. The investigation raises concerns that other venture capital firms might become more cautious about demanding board
